name: git-review
description: Git Review: a status-bar button opens your GitLab merge requests (yours and your group's), grouped by project; pick one and a new terminal runs a full review: conflicts, worktree, pipelines and scans, Sonar, the project's own code review, and a files-and-secrets check of every commit.

group.title: GitLab group
group.description: The group whose open merge requests are listed beside yours

codeRoots.title: Code folders
codeRoots.description: Folders searched (5 levels deep) for a local clone of an MR's project, separated by spaces or commas

allowedPaths.title: Allowed paths
allowedPaths.description: File patterns the files-and-secrets check allows in every project (e.g. google-services.json), separated by spaces or commas. Matches are still listed in the report as allowed.
